args.assumptions: CRS EPSG:32630 for all layers, 25 m cells (0.0625 ha). DEM has no -9999 cells, so no nodata masking was needed. Slope from Horn method in degrees; suitable if slope <= 7 deg. Landcover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected areas: A buffered 250 m, B buffered 400 m (buffers applied per designation), rasterized on cell centres, all three polygons excluded. Grid line: max cell distance 1800 m, so all cells satisfy the 5 km limit. Required land = 50 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 80 ha, so the largest parcel (375.44 ha, 8-connected, 6 patches) is feasible. Yield: pvlib clear-sky Ineichen model, 30 deg fixed tilt, PR 0.80, 50 MW; the tool notes this is an upper bound, not a bankable yield.

Land required = 2 ha/MW x 80 MW = 160 ha. Slope rule: suitable if slope <= 5 degrees (Horn slope, 25 m DEM). DEM has no nodata cells (min 465 m, no -9999 values), so no cells were excluded for missing elevation. Landcover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected areas: PA-1 and PA-3 are designation A (150 m buffer), PA-2 is designation B (500 m buffer); both buffers were applied to the vector polygons in EPSG:32630 (reprojected from EPSG:4326) and rasterized with cell-centre rule; buffered areas excluded. Grid line (132 kV) reprojected to EPSG:32630; distance to line max on grid is 1800 m, so all cells satisfy the 10 km limit. Parcels are 8-connected (8 patches). Mask suit_mask = slope<=5 AND cropland/scrub AND NOT protected buffers. Yield: clear-sky pvlib upper bound for 80 MW, 30 degree fixed tilt, PR 0.80; not a bankable estimate. No conflicting documents were present (only readme.txt).

Required land = 80 MW x 2 ha/MW = 160 ha; largest parcel 23.69 ha is far below it, so infeasible and yield set to 0 per the brief (clear-sky yield not computed). Grid: 120x120 cells at 25 m (0.0625 ha per cell), EPSG:32630 for all layers, so no reprojection was needed. DEM sentinel -9999 declared as nodata (1145 cells). Slope computed with Horn method in degrees; slope <= 3 deg kept (inclusive). Cells touching nodata were excluded explicitly by growing the nodata mask by 1 cell (1435 cells) and removing it, in addition to the slope tool's own nodata propagation. Land cover: only cropland (1) and scrub (2) kept. Protected areas: A features buffered 250 m, B feature buffered 500 m, each rasterized with cell-centre rule (all_touched = false) and combined; cells inside any buffer or the protected area itself were excluded. Grid line: all cells lie within 1.8 km of the 132 kV line (max distance 1800 m), so the 8 km limit excludes nothing. Parcels: 8-connected, 24 patches, largest 23.69 ha. Final mask suit_final = 1915 cells (119.69 ha). The brief's 'feasible' check uses the largest parcel, not the total suitable area.

Land required = 30 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 48 ha. Slope limit 7 deg (Horn slope, cell <= 7 kept). Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. DEM has no nodata cells (declared -9999 already set as nodata; none present), so no nodata exclusion applied. Protected areas: PA-2 (designation B) had a self-intersection, repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. Buffers 150 m (A) and 600 m (B) applied; a cell is excluded if its centre falls inside the protected polygon or its buffer. Protected polygons themselves are inside their buffers so are excluded. Grid line distance max is 1.8 km, so all cells are within 5 km; the distance criterion is non-binding. Cell centres used for all zone and distance tests. Parcels are 8-connected. Yield: pvlib Ineichen clear-sky upper bound at 30 MW, 30 deg fixed tilt, PR 0.80, not a bankable yield. Earlier protected-area layer and grid-line layer are in EPSG:32630, same as DEM, so no reprojection needed.

Required land: 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Buffers: 650 ft = 198.12 m (designation A), 1650 ft = 502.92 m (designation B), 6 mi = 9656.06 m to the 132 kV line. Slope computed in percent (Horn) from the DEM; the DEM has no -9999 cells, so no no-data declaration was needed. Slope <= 5% kept (inclusive). Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Protected-area buffers applied per designation (A and B buffered separately, unioned) and judged at cell centres. Line distance max on grid is 1800 m, so every cell is within 6 miles. Parcels are 8-connected. Clear-sky yield set to 0 because the largest parcel (33.4 ha) is below the 80.9 ha required, so the site is not feasible. Mask 'suitable_mask' = slope<=5% AND cropland/scrub AND within line distance AND outside A (+198 m) and B (+503 m) buffers: 2067 cells, 129.19 ha, 22 patches.
